|game_text='''Front side — Utapau (Republic Controlled)'''

'''Light Side:''' If you control, Jedi deploy -1 to Utapau sites.

'''Dark Side:''' If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at an Utapau site, 'conquer' (flip) Utapau.

'''Back side — Utapau (Separatist Controlled)'''

'''Light Side:''' If you just initiated a Force drain (or won a battle) at an Utapau site, 'conquer' (flip) Utapau.

'''Dark Side:''' During battle here, you may draw one battle destiny if unable to otherwise.
